migrations.name: owner_notification_delivery
migrations.verification_query:
select (
  to_regclass('public.owner_push_subscriptions') is not null
  and to_regclass('public.notification_outbox') is not null
  and to_regclass('public.notification_delivery_attempts') is not null
  and to_regprocedure('public.notification_get_secret(text)') is not null
  and to_regprocedure('public.notification_owner_email()') is not null
  and to_regprocedure('public.notification_enqueue_from_crm()') is not null
  and to_regprocedure('public.notification_claim_outbox(integer)') is not null
  and to_regprocedure('public.notification_requeue_blocked(text)') is not null
  and to_regprocedure('public.notification_delivery_health()') is not null
  and exists (
    select 1
    from pg_trigger
    where tgname = 'crm_notifications_delivery_outbox'
      and tgrelid = 'public.crm_notifications'::regclass
      and not tgisinternal
  )
  and (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.owner_push_subscriptions'::regclass)
  and (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.notification_outbox'::regclass)
  and (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.notification_delivery_attempts'::regclass)
) as verified

migrations.name: notification_dispatch_runtime
migrations.verification_query:
select (
  to_regclass('public.notification_dispatch_runtime') is not null
  and to_regprocedure('public.notification_begin_dispatch(integer)') is not null
  and to_regprocedure('public.notification_dispatch_tick()') is not null
) as verified
